title: West Maui residents offered free bulky item recycling at Go Green event July 18
text:
West Maui residents offered free bulky item recycling at Go Green event July 18
West Maui residents may recycle bulky items for free at the Go Green Recycling event, scheduled from 8 a.m. to noon on July 18 at 300 Lahainaluna Road near the Pioneer Mill smokestack, with entry off Kuhua Street.
The event is open only to residential drop-offs, and appointments are required. Residents can request an appointment online. The program allows for the disposal of air conditioners, lead acid batteries, washers and dryers, dishwashers, microwaves, refrigerators, stoves, water heaters, tires, scrap metals, and electronics such as TVs, computers, printers and monitors along with associated electrical cords. Commercial drop-offs will not be accepted.
Adults are being sought for one-hour volunteer shifts during the event. Organizers will provide a water bottle refill cooler, snacks, and personal protective equipment to volunteers. Registration details for volunteering are available online.
The free recycling opportunity is hosted by nonprofit Mālama Maui Nui in partnership with the County of Maui Department of Environmental Management Environmental Protection & Sustainability Division and its Abandoned Vehicles and Metals Section.
For more information about future Go Green Recycling events or accepted recyclables as well as appointments or volunteer opportunities, residents may contact Mālama Maui Nui at (808) 877-2524 or County DEM Abandoned Vehicles and Metals Section at (808) 270-6102.
